title: Officials evasive on crash materials of unknown origin

tellings.quote: possession. I was told by way of omission when it comes to the subject of do we have materials in our possession. Okay. There's been a wishy-washy response to that.

plain: Officials are said to dodge the question of whether the United States holds material from crashed craft of unknown origin. Peter Levenda, a guest billed on the show as a CIA historian, tells Michels he was answered "by way of omission" whenever he asked whether such materials are in government hands, and that the response has been "wishy-washy". He reads the evasion as a hint that something is being held back.
